reviews.text: Chiara is amazing with both our dogs, even one who can be very anxious. They love their walks with her and she sends great videos that let us see what they’ve been up to. We are so grateful to have found her.
Chiara is truly dedicated to the well-being of the pets entrusted to her, I recommend her!
Thanks Anneke!

We were looking for a trustworthy person to care for our cats and parrot, and we couldn't have found a better one! Chiara is incredibly attentive and dedicated to caring for the animals. She shares everything with us at every visit, with videos and messages, and she spends a lot of time with them, playing with them and lovingly cuddling them. She will definitely be our trusted pet sitter in the future. I highly recommend Chiara without a doubt.

Incredible service: we needed a dog sitter while we were visiting the Pinacoteca di Milano, and we contacted her the same day. She adapted, took our two dogs, played with them in the park, and we were able to enjoy the exhibition stress-free. A thousand thanks from us, but especially from our dogs, who were thrilled to meet her 💕💕

I had a truly excellent experience with Chiara from Pawse Milano. From the very first moment, she proved to be reliable, attentive, and above all, incredibly sweet with my Leon. ❤️
Her presence was constant and reassuring: lots of cuddles, sweet words, and genuine attention to his well-being. She never limited herself to simply managing his food and litter box, but dedicated time and care to Leon, making him feel cared for and pampered even in my absence.
A serious, punctual service, performed with true passion. I felt truly at ease knowing that Leon was in good hands.
I recommend Chiara and Pawse Milano without hesitation: someone you can trust, and one to whom I would entrust Leon again without a second thought. 🐾❤️
Chiara is a well-prepared, empathetic, friendly and cheerful professional, reliable and you can see that she has a passion for what she does, I would recommend her with my eyes closed.
Chiara is absolutely prepared, sweet, patient, a great animal lover, attentive, I highly recommend her
You can tell Chiara loves her job. We're so happy to have met her!

Chiara is an extraordinary catsitter, incredibly sweet, kind, and above all, with a love for animals that is immediately apparent. I felt completely at ease knowing my cat was with her, cared for with care, attention, and so much affection. She is a helpful, thoughtful, and reliable person—the kind of person you leave your pets with with a light heart. I would choose her a thousand times over and recommend her wholeheartedly! ♥️

Chiara is a great dog sitter thanks to her attentiveness, availability, and care for all types of dogs. The hardest part is usually finding someone reliable, and in this case, that's absolutely true. We're lucky she could also take care of Gianni!

I had a truly positive experience with Chiara from Pawse Milano. Today she took Sirtaky out for a walk and immediately proved to be incredibly helpful, kind, and professional.
She even accommodated my last-minute request for an unexpected event without hesitation, demonstrating great attention and flexibility. She cared for Sirtaky with such sweetness: she took him to the park, let him play, and dedicated her time and attention to him.
She kept me updated even after the walk, telling me how it went and how Stirtaky had behaved, making me feel at ease, knowing he had been in excellent hands.
When he returned home, he was so happy and at peace.
It's rare to find such reliable and caring people, capable of making both dog and owner feel at ease.
I absolutely recommend Chiara to anyone looking for someone they can completely trust for their four-legged friend!

I'm really happy to have met Chiara. For me, the most important quality is reliability, especially because I have a very demanding job and need to know that Leo is in good hands. I always feel at ease with her, knowing I can count on someone who is serious, available, and always punctual.
I really appreciate the fact that she always sends me photos, videos, and updates during walks. Besides making me smile and giving me so many memories of Leo, they make me feel involved and demonstrate how attentive and present she is.
Another aspect that makes a difference for me is that she truly dedicates time to Leo, not just a quick walk or handling multiple dogs at once. You can tell she takes care of him carefully, entertains him, helps him socialize with other dogs properly, and even teaches him small, useful behaviors.
Knowing that Leo is with a competent, reliable person who treats him with so much love gives me enormous peace of mind. I recommend Chiara to anyone looking for a professional, punctual person who truly loves what they do.
Chiara is fantastic with our little furry baby who can’t wait to go for a walk with her! And she sends amazing videos too! Great service, highly recommended.
Chiara is very good and attentive with my fearful dog, I recommend her to everyone

Chiara is sweet, reliable, competent, always available, and patient: not only does she take care of our dog, but she also keeps us constantly informed and updated on his mood, needs, and concerns. Highly recommended!

I met Chiara from PAWSE while looking for a dog sitter who could take my dogs for a walk alone at Parco del Lambro (without bringing a group of dogs along).

Chiara is a very kind and reliable person. My two collies accepted her immediately and went on long walks together when I had to leave for a trip abroad and couldn't take them with me. She's passionate about dog training and loves studying canine ethology, which is both wonderful and rare.

She sends me tons of videos of their walks, so I'm always informed, which is fantastic.
Our dogs adore Chiara and have started to behave better outside, at the park, and when they meet other dogs. She is patient, controlled, and joyful with them. Chiara is great!

I was looking for someone reliable to care for my three cats, and I couldn't have made a better choice. Chiara cared for them with care, kindness, and patience, respecting their habits and making me feel at ease every day. When I returned, I found them happy, pampered, and in perfect health. You can really see how much she loves animals: a highly recommended cat sitter for anyone who wants to leave their cats in good hands. 🐾💛

We had a really good experience.
Chiara was attentive and thoughtful; we were pleasantly surprised from the first contact.
We absolutely recommend her.

5 stars for Chiara! My dog ​​Lucrezia adores her, and I feel comfortable entrusting her to her when I'm not around.
Chiara is thoughtful and attentive on walks and at the park!
I've never seen a more passionate and attentive dog lover than Chiara; punctual, responsible, and above all, happy to take care of the little dogs.

Chiara has been helping me with my two furry friends for months. I highly recommend her because she's very professional, attentive to my puppies' needs, helpful, and above all, RELIABLE!

Thank you Chiara for your continued support!

Mya, Marcello, and Valerio
🏳️‍🌈🐕🐶🐾♥️

Chiara is wonderful; she looked after my dog ​​for a week a while ago. I think the attention, affection, and care she has given him are priceless. My furry friend has grown incredibly attached despite the short time he's had. :)

Chiara from Pawse Milano is a fantastic pet sitter! She cared for my three cats for a week while I was on vacation, and I couldn't have asked for more. The kittens were lovingly cared for, she played with them, and cuddled them endlessly, in addition to, of course, feeding them, changing their water, and cleaning their litter boxes. Chiara loves animals and caring for them comes completely naturally to her, whether they're dogs, cats, ferrets, or anything else. For every visit, I received photos and videos of my furry children, so throughout my time away, I felt informed and at peace, knowing my cats were in excellent hands. I couldn't recommend Chiara more highly to anyone who wants their pets to be taken care of in the best possible way.
Entrusting your dog is like entrusting a part of yourself. With Chiara, I feel at ease; I know my dogs are safe with her. She's serious, meticulous, and reliable.
